description: This is a FastAPI backend API implementation for a career pathway navigator application. It provides endpoints for health checks, role and skill management, progress tracking, graph generation, recommendations, assessments, and roadmap CRUD operations, integrating with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: RoleSkill
classes.description: Association model linking roles and skills, including recommendations and colors.

classes.name: Recommendation
classes.description: Model representing recommendations for role-skill pairs.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.description: Endpoint to list all roles with descriptions.

methods.name: get_role_detail
methods.description: Fetch detailed information about a role by name, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: get_role_detail_by_id
methods.description: Fetch detailed information about a role by ID.

methods.name: list_skills
methods.description: List all skills with categories and descriptions.

methods.name: get_skill_detail
methods.description: Fetch skill details by ID, including roles that require it.

methods.name: get_skill_detail_by_name
methods.description: Fetch skill details by name, including roles that require it.

methods.name: get_role_progress
methods.description: List progress entries for a specific role.

methods.name: set_progress
methods.description: Create or update progress for a role and skill.

methods.name: get_graph
methods.description: Generate a D3-compatible graph showing role transition and skill gaps.

methods.name: get_recommendations
methods.description: Retrieve recommendations for a specific role and skill.

methods.name: assess_roles
methods.description: Assess strengths and gaps between current and target roles.

methods.name: create_roadmap
methods.description: Create and save a new roadmap.

methods.name: list_roadmaps
methods.description: List saved roadmaps, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: get_roadmap
methods.description: Fetch a specific roadmap by ID.
